notes.content: This agreement displays all lower-division courses required in the major: CSU Northridge courses on the left, approved (articulated) transfer courses to the right. General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree. Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not mandatory prior to admission. For CSU Northridge Undergraduate Admission Requirements , refer to Upper Division Transfer . Some coursework may be satisfied by Advanced Placement exams completed in high school. Visit AP Credit for information. Additional information about the major is available in the CSUN University Catalog . Questions regarding this agreement may be directed to: articulation@csun.edu .
notes.contentHtml:
This agreement displays all lower-division courses required in the major: CSU Northridge courses on the left, approved (articulated) transfer courses to the right. General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree.


Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not mandatory prior to admission. For CSU Northridge Undergraduate Admission Requirements, refer to Upper Division Transfer.


Some coursework may be satisfied by Advanced Placement exams completed in high school. Visit AP Credit for information. Additional information about the major is available in the CSUN University Catalog.


Questions regarding this agreement may be directed to: articulation@csun.edu.

notes.content: Admission to the major in Music for all undergraduate degrees is determined by audition. Audition procedures and standards are listed on the Department of Music—Audition and Placement website. Credit will be granted for lessons taken previously up to the skill level demonstrated. Maximum of 8 units of ensemble and 8 units of individual lessons will be accepted on transfer for the B.M., subject to placement testing.
